Records the same change in the shared legacy UCPath module's contract, selector, and lesson files — the receipt pair, the two RECORD_FIELD-anchored detail selectors and their 2026-08-04 live verification, and the rule that the URL is never state evidence on that route. No executable path changes here, but these files are the ported page-state record every UCPath capability's rebuild port is read from. The rebuild already encodes the corrected proof as D130 (doc 09 §13.6 and the §2.2 UCPath proofSchema): the receipt completion arm is the pair (transactionNumber, approvalStatus), read together or not at all, with an unknown id proved by field resolution rather than URL. The rebuild therefore needs no source change to stay parity-correct, and the recheck is closed by that ratified decision plus a green rebuild gate run.

Every legacy capability that drives UCPath consumes this module, and its selectors and outcome rules are what the rebuild ports. The rebuild already encodes the corrected proof as D130 (doc 09 §13.6 and the §2.2 UCPath proofSchema): the receipt completion arm is the pair (transactionNumber, approvalStatus), read together or not at all, with an unknown id proved by field resolution rather than URL. Documentation only — appends one LESSONS.md entry recording a live-verified UCPath break: PeopleSoft now points each Find-an-Existing-Value search input's aria-labelledby at the label AND the adjacent operator select, so every exact: true textbox arm matched zero elements while the one non-exact arm silently survived. No legacy executable path changes in this commit, so no legacy behavior moved. It is recorded against every UCPath consumer because LESSONS.md is the shared ported page-state record those capabilities' rebuild selectors are derived from, and this entry invalidates the recorded accessible names for the Person Org Summary search form. The rebuild has not yet ported a Person Org Summary search locator, so no rebuild source change is implied and the recheck is closed by a green rebuild gate run.

Documentation only — edits the same LESSONS.md entry to correct the blast radius it claimed: Workforce Job Summary, not PayPath Actions, is the search form production drives, and it is structurally immune because its only textbox arm is written non-exact; payPathActions keeps the fragile exact: true shape but is left unedited rather than changed unverified. Adds the carry-forward rule that a Find-an-Existing-Value search textbox must never be pinned exact on the bare label. No legacy executable path changes in this commit, so no legacy behavior moved. It is recorded against every UCPath consumer for the same reason as its predecessor — LESSONS.md is the shared ported page-state record — and because it narrows which ported selector shapes the rebuild must avoid. No rebuild source change is implied and the recheck is closed by a green rebuild gate run.
